entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: A mighty, opulent, dynastic absolute monarchy in the Edge made up of many species, systems and worlds, under a divine emperor.

entities.name: Taman IV
entities.description: The divine emperor and current Regent Maximum of the Celestial Palatinate.

entities.name: Taman Dynasty
entities.description: The ruling dynasty of the Palatinate.

entities.name: Cosmogrands
entities.description: The near-absolute monarch nobility of the Palatinate, each ruling at least one world and enacting the Regent's will.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: A large free company, the Regent Maximum's favored regiment and de facto state army of the Palatinate.

entities.name: Summism
entities.description: The syncretic state religion of the Palatinate, worshiping the Grand Cosmocordance through the Bright Sum.

entities.name: Grand Cosmocordance
entities.description: Physics as understood by the Summists, the core of Summist worship.

entities.name: Bright Sum
entities.description: A living prophetic compass, the figure remaining at the end of the faithful's tabulation of the universe's data.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: Something the Summists see as anathema and work to prevent by reigniting supervoids.

entities.name: Horizon javelins
entities.description: Colossal star-reviving weapons used by Summists to reignite supervoids.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: Founders of the Palatinate whose teachings created the foundations of Summism, a closely guarded secret.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: A faith competing with Summism as most widespread in Pinnacle space.

entities.name: Monoist Monasteriat
entities.description: The faction engaged with the Palatinate in the Entropy War.

entities.name: Entropy War
entities.description: A war between the Celestial Palatinate and the Monoist Monasteriat.

entities.name: First Regent Maximum
entities.description: According to legend, a female dragon who gifted the Palatinate lightforging.

entities.name: Anstruth
entities.description: Acting against the Grand Cosmocordance, considered anti-doctrinal and blasphemous.

entities.name: The Edge
entities.description: The region in which the Celestial Palatinate lies.

events.summary: The Palatinate is founded by the Astelli before Pinnacle and faster-than-light travel.
events.quote: Founded by the Astelli before Pinnacle and the introduction of faster-than-light travel

events.summary: The Regent Maximum's divine investiture arises at the conclusion of a series of unification wars.
events.quote: Its divine investiture is a relatively recent development in the Palatinate's history

events.summary: According to legend the first Regent Maximum, a female dragon, gifts the Palatinate lightforging.
events.quote: According to legend, the first Regent Maximum was a female dragon who gifted the Palatinate a technique known as lightforging.

events.summary: The Celestial Palatinate and the Monoist Monasteriat are at war in the Entropy War.
events.quote: The Celestial Palatinate and the Monoist Monasteriat are engaged in the Entropy War .
